name: Streaming Collective Investment Management 9Fa4Eff5D7
text: Collective Investment Management states that financial-stability objectives have come to shape the regime because collective investment management is associated with non-bank financial intermediation. This independently corresponds to Kaal's account of bank-like fund activity and liquidity transformation carrying financial-stability consequences. The abstract does not isolate hedge funds or quantify systemic risk.
